verdicts.reason: Independent Italian importer and distributor of third-party APIs (part of distributor group Prodotti Gianni, not a manufacturer), supplying oncology small molecule APIs such as Letrozole.

Conderco S.A. is an active pharmaceutical raw material distributor and trader in Latin America that sources and distributes third-party European and Asian APIs, including numerous small molecule oncology APIs such as Abiraterone, Anastrozole, Azacitidine, Bendamustine, Bicalutamide, Bortezomib, Cabazitaxel, Capecitabine, Carboplatin, and Carfilzomib, without manufacturing its own products.
